sections.title: Sound of há
paragraphs: The letter (há) /haː/ sounds like the start of (ház) /ˈhaːz/, which means house. This letter makes three distinct sounds in Hungarian words, and in some positions it remains completely silent.

sections.title: How to say há
paragraphs: Breathe out gently through an open throat without any voice. Next, make that same breathy sound while your vocal cords vibrate. For the third sound, raise the back of your tongue near the roof of your mouth to create rough friction. Put your hand on your throat to feel the voice turn on and off.

sections.title: Spelling of há
paragraphs: At the start of words, say the sound /h/, that is a voiceless h, as in (tehén) /ˈtɛheːn/. Between two vowels, use the sound /ɦ/, that is a voiced h, as in (lehelet) /ˈlɛɦɛlɛt/. At the end of words like (düh) /ˈdyx/, use the rough sound /x/. Finally, the letter is not pronounced at the end of certain words, such as (cseh) /ˈt͡ʃɛ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not drop this letter at the start of words like hat. Always breathe out firmly. Do not pronounce the silent letter at the end of certain words like tea. In words that keep the ending sound, do not use the clean sound of lock. Instead, push air through a tight gap at the back of your throat.
